entries.name: Flower group
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, three cup-shaped blooms on thin stems (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan source (Quaternius "Flower group" GLB on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Flowers.fbx from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip and pin as the tree, tree-pine, tree-autumn and bush entries, so they read as one set. It is a clump of three cup-shaped blooms (four petals each, open card petals) on thin stems with short leaf stubs; it reads clearly as flowers, so the pack's Plant_* foliage clumps were not needed. Height 0.4 m: garden or meadow flowers (tulips, cosmos, poppies) stand 0.3-0.5 m, about knee height on a 1.6 m person; the source's own proportions (0.24 x 0.40 x 0.30 m at that height) give stems about 6 mm thick, as a tulip stem. Colours on meadow: stems and leaf stubs mid green (iris) shading to deep green (hair), dark enough that the thin stems hold against the pale sky; petals cream (moon) shading to buttercup yellow (practical), so the cups read bright and warm against the greens; the small flower centres red (accent) shading to deep green, a distinct eye inside the cream and yellow. Petals are open cards, so petals and leaves are double-sided. Static: no clips.
